english_title: Proposition 2.1: Generalization of the Silverman-Toeplitz Theorem
statement_en:
Let $a_{n,k}$ be a double sequence such that:
1. the sum over $k$ tends asymptotically to $1$, namely $$\lim_{n\to\infty}\sum_{k=1}^n a_{n,k}=1,$$
2. for each fixed $k$, $$\lim_{n\to\infty} a_{n,k}=0,$$
3. $$\sup_{n\in\mathbb{N}^{+}}\sum_{k\le n}|a_{n,k}|<+\infty.$$
Then for every convergent sequence $x_n$, one has
$$\lim_{n\to\infty}\sum_{k=1}^n a_{n,k}x_k=\lim_{n\to\infty}x_n.$$
final_code:
import Mathlib

open Filter Topology BigOperators

theorem silvermanToeplitz_real
    (a : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (l : ℝ)
    (h_sum_one : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 n) (fun k => a n k)) Filter.atTop (nhds 1))
    (h_pointwise : ∀ k : ℕ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => a n k) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    (h_bdd : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n : ℕ, Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 n) (fun k => |a n k|) ≤ C)
    (h_conv : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds l)) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 n) (fun k => a n k * x k)) Filter.atTop (nhds l) := by
